weapon.d: Grants Def+3. Grants Atk/Def+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of allies within 2 spaces of unit: 0 allies grants +6; 1 ally grants +4; 2 allies grants +2; ≥3 allies grants +0.) If the number of allies within 2 spaces is ≤ 1, neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

b.d: If unit's HP ≤ 25% and foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack before foe's first attack.
If unit's HP ≤ 50% and foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack before foe's first attack.
If unit's HP ≤ 75% and foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack before foe's first attack.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+2 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 to unit for 1 turn.
